title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 3 November 2026
description: Australian-led researchers report preserved dinosaur blood cells in a 115-million-year-old fossil, construction begins on a major north Queensland wind and battery project, and two Gold Coast residents are nominated for Queensland Australian of the Year awards. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
